0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000010_ERENVILLE
0.description: The fierce Xbr'aal hunters who laid claim to this land call it the azure forest─Yak T'el.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000020_ERENVILLE
1.description: Battered by meteors in ancient times and colored mesmerizing shades of blue and green by nature, it is easy to understand why the place is so named.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000030_ERENVILLE
2.description: It is here, where the Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja once battled for dominance, that the rite of succession would reach its climax...

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000060_WUKLAMAT
5.description: I've never been good with heights...

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000070_ALPHINAUD
6.description: The vegetation is far denser than in Kozama'uka.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000080_ERENVILLE
7.description: I suggest you pay more attention to the ground unless you want to walk straight into a cenote.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000100_ERENVILLE
9.description: Sinkholes filled with rain and groundwater. Many meteors fell here long ago, it is said, and after they struck the earth, it became susceptible to erosion.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000105_ERENVILLE
10.description: Deep as some of the pits are, you'll not climb out in a hurry should you take a tumble.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000130_ALPHINAUD
13.description: Is the Xbr'aal community depicted in the Lay of Repast close by?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000140_ERENVILLE
14.description: Aye. We need but follow the path a short way west.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000150_WUKLAMAT
15.description: Right, I can't stand here with my knees knocking forever. Let's get going!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000160_SAREELJA
16.description: At last we are graced by the presence of the Third Promise.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000170_BAKOOLJAJA
17.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)If I'd known we'd be waiting on your mangy hide, I wouldn't have bothered with Valigarmanda in the first place.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000180_WUKLAMAT
18.description: You self-serving piece of wivre dung! Do you have any idea how many could've been hurt!?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000190_HUNMURRUK
19.description: (-Gentle Villager-)Now that we are assembled, let us begin.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000200_HUNMURRUK
20.description: My name is Hunmu Rruk. As Xbr'aax Rax, I have the honor of serving as elector on behalf of my people.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000210_HUNMURRUK
21.description: As all four claimants must be present for this feat, we have eagerly awaited your arrival.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000215_HUNMURRUK
22.description: Third Promise, if you would please join us.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000220_HUNMURRUK
23.description: Thus far, you have faced each other as rivals. The Feat of Repast, however, will test your cooperation. You must complete this challenge in teams of two.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000230_BAKOOLJAJA
24.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What!? You expect us to work with one of these weaklings!?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000240_HUNMURRUK
25.description: Be warned─only the triumphant team will receive keystones. I advise you to cooperate with your partner.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000250_HUNMURRUK
26.description: Teams will be decided by lots. Those who draw the same color will be paired accordingly.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000260_ALISAIE
27.description: Twelve forbid Wuk Lamat is paired with Bakool Ja Ja. After all he's put her through, I wouldn't blame her if she did something rash. I might even help.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000300_HUNMURRUK
31.description: On separate teams, then. And the rest?

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000320_KOANA
33.description: Together again, as fate would have it.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000340_URIANGER
35.description: With our claimants thus paired, so too is their opposition...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000350_BAKOOLJAJA
36.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ugh, not the one-head...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000360_HUNMURRUK
37.description: Listen well, for the trial that awaits you is as follows...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000370_HUNMURRUK
38.description: Each team is to prepare a sample of traditional Xbr'aal cuisine─xibruq pibil.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000380_SAREELJA
39.description: And now we must cook. Another ludicrous feat.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000390_WUKLAMAT
40.description: So it might seem, but there's bound to be deeper meaning to it.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000400_KOANA
41.description: Agreed. Given that the very future of our nation is at stake, all parts of this rite must have significance.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000410_THANCRED
42.description: Our Promises have grown rather promising, wouldn't you say?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000420_ALPHINAUD
43.description: Indeed. If I were to guess at the significance of the feat...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000430_ALPHINAUD
44.description: Few things reflect the history and development of a culture so clearly as its culinary traditions.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000440_ALISAIE
45.description: The variety of stewed dishes in Garlean cuisine bespeaks their agricultural roots and cold climes, true.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000450_WUKLAMAT
46.description: The peoples we've met on our journey─they've all had different practices involving food and drink.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000460_WUKLAMAT
47.description: The Hanuhanu replenish their magical energies with reeds, while the Pelupelu have turned their fondness of beverages into a living.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000470_WUKLAMAT
48.description: So basically, to know a people's cuisine is to know something of their ways!

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000480_KOANA
49.description: With each feat, we have deepened our familiarity with a given community's history and culture...

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000490_KOANA
50.description: Is this what Father intended for us all along...?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000500_KOANA
51.description: But a leader with his vision must see that the past doesn't hold the answers we need. It is through embracing innovation, not adhering to tradition, that we will usher Tuliyollal unto a more prosperous future.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000520_HUNMURRUK
53.description: The first team to prepare and partake of satisfactory xibruq pibil will be deemed victorious. You will be judged by your samples' taste and appearance, as well as your adherence to appropriate cooking techniques.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000530_HUNMURRUK
54.description: Kitchens have been made available for your use. Note that you may be asked to retry should your dish fail to pass muster.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000540_HUNMURRUK
55.description: Let the Feat of Repast begin.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000550_WUKLAMAT
56.description: I've never actually heard of xibruq pibil before. What's it like, I wonder...

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000560_WUKEVU
57.description: This is where most battles were fought between the Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja─the Xobr'it Cinderfield.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000570_KOANA
58.description: A field of cinders, indeed... How fierce their clashes must have been.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000580_WUKEVU
59.description: The war over these lands began after the Yok Huy's departure some five hundred years ago.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000590_WUKEVU
60.description: And for four centuries thereafter, the two enemies repaid violence with violence. A constant stream of minor skirmishes punctuated by massive slaughter.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000600_KOANA
61.description: Until Father ended their endless conflict eighty years ago.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000610_WUKEVU
62.description: Accompanied by a retinue of only six, the Dawnservant opposed both armies and brought the fighting to a standstill.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000620_WUKLAMAT
63.description: First they seal Valigarmanda at full strength, and now this...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000630_WUKEVU
64.description: It was during this armistice that both sides gathered for negotiations at the Dawnservant's behest.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000640_GULOOLJAJA
65.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)For too long you have been bound by your ancestors' violent legacy. It is past time you broke free of it!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000650_XBALAALMALEVILLAGER
66.description: Tell that to the scale-scum! We fight to protect what is rightfully ours. If not for their greed, we'd be living in peace!

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000660_HOOBIGOMALEVILLAGER
67.description: Puff your tails and scurry off, then! Cowards like you ill deserve the bounty of this forest.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000670_GULOOLJAJA
68.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Even should one of you succeed in vanquishing the other, your triumph will last only until a new invader arrives.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000680_GULOOLJAJA
69.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Tell me─do you know of the vast continent that lies far to the east, where numerous nations vie for dominance?

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000690_GULOOLJAJA
70.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)You do not─and why should you? Affairs beyond the salt we have no intention to cross are of no consequence to us.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000700_GULOOLJAJA
71.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Not until those affairs come to Tural─like our honored visitor here.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000720_HOOBIGOMALEVILLAGER
73.description: I've been to the ocean before, and it's nothing but water farther than the eye can see! What sort of vessel could possibly reach its end?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000730_GULOOLJAJA
74.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)That such technology exists is indisputable─as is foreign powers' awareness of Tural.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000740_GULOOLJAJA
75.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)If any such country were to develop a taste for Turali soil, and bring to bear the might of innovations we can only imagine─what do you suppose happens then?

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000750_GULOOLJAJA
76.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)You do not know the warlords of the east. But you know that if they came, they would not settle for a single forest.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000760_GULOOLJAJA
77.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)By joining hands, we might create a unified front─an alliance capable of repelling them or any other foe.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000770_GULOOLJAJA
78.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)There is no greater proof of this than my companions and I. Alone we are weak, but together we triumphed over Valigarmanda.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000785_HOOBIGOMALEVILLAGER
80.description: I'd take you for a liar if the sting of our own defeat wasn't still fresh.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000790_XBALAALMALEVILLAGER
81.description: Their coordination was indeed impressive. How the Pelupelu stymied our efforts to cripple the Yok Huy's legs and defend our ballistas...

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000800_XBALAALMALEVILLAGER
82.description: And when we withdrew to strike again from a distance, the Hanuhanu called the winds to make our arrows miss their marks. In seeking to exploit their weaknesses, we only subjected ourselves to their strengths.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000810_GULOOLJAJA
83.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Those strengths are born of cooperation─the guiding principle of the nation we envision.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000820_XBALAALMALEVILLAGER
84.description: But our feud has lasted for centuries. How do you expect us to join hands now?

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000830_GULOOLJAJA
86.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)Give us an evening to convince you.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000840_WUKEVU
87.description: And so began that legendary banquet.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000850_WUKEVU
88.description: One would not expect sworn enemies to abruptly drink to each other's health. And indeed, a tense silence hung over the venue.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000860_WUKEVU
89.description: But then the Dawnservant called for the exchange of traditional cuisine. So it was that the Mamool Ja partook of spiced meat, and the Xbr'aal steamed najool.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000870_WUKEVU
90.description: Before long, delight manifested upon the faces of those present, each side impressed by the other's dish. Seeing this, the Dawnservant laughed and declared once more.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000875_WUKEVU
91.description: Their flavors, he said, would be even better combined. And he proceeded to help them prepare the new creation.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000890_WUKEVU
93.description: It is a marriage of Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja cultures, and proof of their newfound cooperation.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000900_WUKEVU
94.description: The Dawnservant had asked for a single evening, but the feasting is said to have lasted three days and three nights, so delicious was their repast.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000910_WUKEVU
95.description: In the end, a peace accord was reached, and the Dawnservant's words at that time still illuminate our way forward.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000920_GULOOLJAJA
96.description: (-Vow of Reason Gulool Ja Ja-)Ignorance begets strife.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000930_GULOOLJAJA
97.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)Understanding begets fellowship.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000960_WUKLAMAT
101.description: It's just...to think that he ended an age-old conflict with food... It's all so absurd, yet somehow so very Papa, I couldn't help but laugh.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000980_WUKEVU
103.description: Now then, I trust you understand the significance of xibruq pibil and the history it has written?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_000990_WUKLAMAT
104.description: Absolutely! Thank you for sharing the story with us.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001020_KOANA
107.description: Perhaps our competition is cooking up some scheme or another.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001030_WUKLAMAT
108.description: Something bitter and half-baked, no doubt...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001050_SAREELJA
110.description: Good, there is still time. I shall prepare our sample at once.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001060_BAKOOLJAJA
111.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)At first I wasn't sure about being stuck with the one-head, but better that than playing nanny to the mewling house cat.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001070_WUKLAMAT
112.description: Be quiet, Bakool Ja Ja. No one cares what you think.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001080_BAKOOLJAJA
113.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hmph. Act tough all you like. Victory will be ours.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001100_KRILE
115.description: Apologies for the wait. We submit to you our xibruq pibil.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001120_KRILE
117.description: The dish is prepared by using the culinary techniques of the Mamool Ja to cook the spiced meats favored by the Xbr'aal.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001130_KRILE
118.description: It is a symbol of peace between their two peoples after centuries of war.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001140_HUNMURRUK
121.description: Both the ingredients and your methods appear to have been correct. Now then...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001150_HUNMURRUK
122.description: In taste, texture, and aroma, you have recreated xibruq pibil admirably.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001160_HUNMURRUK
123.description: Granted, anyone might well achieve similar results by following the recipe to the letter.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001170_HUNMURRUK
124.description: But you went a step further. You sought to learn the cultural significance of the dish─about Yak T'el's history of violence and your father's role in ending it.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001180_HUNMURRUK
125.description: Your willingness to take lessons from the past befits aspiring Dawnservants, and for that I commend you.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001190_HUNMURRUK
126.description: All that remains is to partake of your creation. True understanding is gained only through experience.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001200_WUKLAMAT
127.description: Now this is something I'm definitely good at!

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001210_SAREELJA
128.description: Ahem. I believe we have yet to receive our assessment.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001220_SAREELJA
129.description: Ours is also a faithful example of xibruq pibil, as you will no doubt agree.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001240_HUNMURRUK
133.description: While your effort looks the part, unlike the Second and Third Promises' dish, it lacks its defining aroma.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001260_SAREELJA
135.description: The meat was marinated in spice before being steamed in an earthen oven! This is xibruq pibil!

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001270_HUNMURRUK
136.description: Oh? And what about the Ja Tiika banana leaf?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001290_BAKOOLJAJA
138.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)It's because of you that we couldn't get any damned leaves! You can't fault us!

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001300_HUNMURRUK
139.description: But the Second and Third Promises had no such difficulty, did they? That which they needed they acquired simply by showing interest in our history and heritage.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001310_BAKOOLJAJA
140.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)It's just some crusty old leaf! What difference could it make!?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001320_HUNMURRUK
141.description: Your dish lacks an essential ingredient. As you have failed to demonstrate an adequate understanding of xibruq pibil, I must deem your performance unsatisfactory. Your team will not receive keystones.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001330_BAKOOLJAJA
142.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hmph. This was stupid anyway.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001340_KRILE
143.description: His ambition only grows more intense. That someone could harbor such dark thoughts towards family...

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001350_BAKOOLJAJA
144.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What do I care for this sham of a feat? I can always take what I need later!

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001370_WUKLAMAT
146.description: The ibruq is so tender, it melts in your mouth! And the way the najool leaf rounds out these spices is sublime!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001380_WUKLAMAT
147.description: This is the taste of harmony. Someone who only knows brute force and deception could never appreciate it.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001390_BAKOOLJAJA
148.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Choke on your harmony.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001400_HUNMURRUK
149.description: Come, come, finish your meal. That too is part of the feat.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001410_WUKLAMAT
150.description: You don't have to tell me twice!

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001430_WUKLAMAT
152.description: You've got real culinary talent. If you ever tire of adventuring, you can always be my personal chef!

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001440_KOANA
153.description: It was palatable enough, I suppose.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001450_HUNMURRUK
154.description: To you who have successfully performed the Feat of Repast, I present these keystones.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001470_KOANA
156.description: Well, I should get going, then.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001480_KOANA
157.description: I'm glad that I...uh, wasn't paired with one of the others.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001490_THANCRED
158.description: We can do better than that, surely.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001500_WUKLAMAT
159.description: The sixth keystone is ours! Thanks for all your help, everyone.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001520_WUKLAMAT
161.description: Um...was there any xibruq pibil left? I could really use another helping...

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001530_WUKLAMAT
162.description: What is the meaning of this? And just how far do you plan on taking us?

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001550_WUKLAMAT
164.description: Bakool Ja Ja, you snake! If you want my keystones so badly, you deal with me and me alone! Leave the elector out of this!

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001570_BAKOOLJAJA
166.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Is that all you think he is? Foolish kitty, this man is the reason we are here.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001580_BAKOOLJAJA
167.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Take a good look at him. Go on, <hex:021A020203>look<hex:021A020103>. Surely you recognize your real father!

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001590_BAKOOLJAJA
168.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Don't believe us? Then ask your trusted sellsword─<hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> heard it straight from the old man's mouth!

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001600_WUKLAMAT
169.description: Is it true? Is Hunmu Rruk my...

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001620_BAKOOLJAJA
171.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Now that you understand the situation, let's see those keystones. I'll even let you fight for them─just you and me.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001630_BAKOOLJAJA
172.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)If that adventurer attempts to interfere...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001640_BAKOOLJAJA
173.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'll kill the old man myself!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001660_WUKLAMAT
175.description: Kinsman or no, I won't stand for you taking hostages!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001670_WUKLAMAT
176.description: Come on, then! You want a fight? I'll give you a fight!

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001675_BAKOOLJAJA
177.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Oooh, such heroic caterwauling, Promise. I'm shaking.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001676_BAKOOLJAJA
178.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Guard our hostage well. We wouldn't want to tempt any thoughts of rescue.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001677_BAKOOLJAJA
179.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)By the by, house cat. They've been instructed to put down Papa dearest when you lose. Hopefully he's settled his affairs.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001680_WUKLAMAT
180.description: Don't worry. I'm not losing to the likes of him.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001690_WUKLAMAT
181.description: Well, what are you waiting for, you blessed bastards!? It's two against one! Don't tell me you're scared!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001700_BAKOOLJAJA
182.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I <hex:021A020203>know<hex:021A020103> I didn't hear you right...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
184.description: Cowards don't stand a chance against Wuk Lamat.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
185.description: You should back down before you get hurt.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
186.description: Don't worry─the scary adventurer won't try anything funny.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001710_BAKOOLJAJA
187.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)You dare call us cowards!?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001720_BAKOOLJAJA
188.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)You think this weakling could hurt <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>!?

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001730_BAKOOLJAJA
189.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Foreign scum! Who are you to mock me!?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001740_BAKOOLJAJA
190.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'll kill you─kill you─kill you <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103>!

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001750_BAKOOLJAJA
191.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Don't look away, salt! I want you to watch as I tear your beloved Promise to shreds!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001760_WUKLAMAT
192.description: Hey, eyes on me. The house cat, remember?

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001770_WUKLAMAT
193.description: I'll say it again: I'm not losing to the likes of you!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001780_WUKLAMAT
194.description: I'm going to become Dawnservant─and I will protect my people!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001800_BAKOOLJAJA
196.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)N-No... How can this be...?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001810_BAKOOLJAJA
197.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)How could that puny house cat beat all of us...?

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001820_WUKLAMAT
198.description: You've caused nothing but trouble with your dirty tricks.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001830_WUKLAMAT
199.description: Threatening the Hanuhanu, releasing Valigarmanda─harassing me is one thing, but you've endangered too many innocents!

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001840_WUKLAMAT
200.description: No more, Bakool Ja Ja! I will not stand for it! If you even <hex:021A020203>think<hex:021A020103> of tormenting my people again, you will answer to me!

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001910_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSA
208.description: And he goes and forgets he had the way blocked...

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001930_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSA
210.description: The only part left in the saga is the Lay of the Brotherhood─in Mamook.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001940_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSA
211.description: The plan was to force you here so we could take the rest of your keystones.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001950_WUKLAMAT
212.description: So that's what he was up to... But, uh, should you be telling us this?

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_001960_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSA
214.description: What does it matter? You've beaten us. It's over.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002000_WUKLAMAT
218.description: So what Bakool Ja Ja said... About you and me...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002010_HUNMURRUK
219.description: I─ Ah, but to single-handedly defeat Bakool Ja Ja! You truly are the Dawnservant's daughter.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002020_HUNMURRUK
220.description: It has been my honor to bear witness to your journey, Promise.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002030_WUKLAMAT
221.description: Promise... Yes, that's what I am.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002040_WUKLAMAT
222.description: I'm Gulool Ja Ja's daughter, and Tuliyollal's next Dawnservant!

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002050_WUKLAMAT
223.description: Come on. Let's rejoin the others.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002060_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
224.description: Earlier, in the Second Promise's camp...

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002070_KOANA
225.description: The passage to Mamook remains blocked. For now, all we can do is try to rest and recover.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002080_KOANA
226.description: ...Perhaps with a meal, as my sister would no doubt suggest. Shall we borrow the kitchens and prepare some xibruq pibil?

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002090_URIANGER
228.description: So thou hast taken a liking to the dish.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002100_URIANGER
229.description: As we learn to appreciate the unfamiliar, 'tis only natural that we develop new affinities. There is no shame in this.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002110_KOANA
230.description: But there is in ignorance. I had barely considered what the people of Tuliyollal hold dear. What hopes they harbor for the future.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002120_KOANA
231.description: Our nation is built upon the bonds that Father forged during his journey across Tural.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002130_KOANA
232.description: But so single-minded have I been in my advocacy of foreign innovations...that I failed to understand my own people.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002140_KOANA
233.description: Could someone who struggles to connect with the populace ever make a worthy Dawnservant?

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002150_THANCRED
234.description: To understand and connect with people is by no means easy.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002160_THANCRED
235.description: But there is something you can do to pave the way.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002170_THANCRED
236.description: Let them see you for who you really are. What makes you laugh and cry and rage. That sort of honesty is the first step towards mutual understanding─and connection.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002180_KOANA
237.description: “Understanding begets fellowship.” As my father said...

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002190_KOANA
238.description: And yet, what you suggest does not come naturally to me...

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002200_URIANGER
239.description: I, too, have found it difficult to speak from the heart. In thy struggles, I see mine own─painful in their familiarity.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002210_URIANGER
240.description: Yet frightening though it may feel, if we are to move forward, we must indeed take that first step. Dispense with pretense and simply <hex:021A020203>be<hex:021A020103>.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002220_THANCRED
241.description: Do you remember when you first approached us, and we asked you why you wanted to become Dawnservant?

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002230_THANCRED
242.description: You said you wished to use the knowledge you acquired in Sharlayan for your country─and in doing so repay your father for the opportunities he afforded you.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002240_THANCRED
243.description: What won me over was not your ambition, but your motivation.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002250_THANCRED
244.description: So let your people know this. And in time, they'll come to support you as we do.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002260_THANCRED
245.description: You can't hide behind that stoicism forever.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002270_KOANA
246.description: Very well, then. I will make a greater effort to be myself...by not being my <hex:021A020203>usual<hex:021A020103> self so much.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002310_ALPHINAUD
250.description: Not as you know him. What you see is an arcane manifestation of the Dawnservant as he was in his prime.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002320_KOANA
251.description: The channeler is Zereel Ja, Autarch of Mamook and elector for the Feat of the Brotherhood.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002330_ZEREELJA
252.description: Tuliyollal's mightiest warrior... Yet wisest you are not. You who spurned your retainer's aid when battling your betters.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002340_ALPHINAUD
253.description: To prove oneself superior to blessed siblings by surpassing the shade of Gulool Ja Ja himself─that is the final feat.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002350_ALPHINAUD
254.description: The First Promise fought alone and fell short...but that is now the least of his concerns.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002360_ZEREELJA
255.description: You could have let your foolishness end with your failure. But instead you attempted to harm an anointed elector.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002370_ZEREELJA
256.description: Zoraal Ja. As of this moment, you are no longer a claimant. I disqualify you from the rite of succession. Begone from my sight.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002380_SAREELJA
257.description: This isn't over yet. I will be the one to reach the golden city.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002390_KOANA
258.description: When Zoraal Ja was defeated, he tried to take the keystone by force. But he was thwarted by Father's shade.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002410_ZEREELJA
260.description: This feat was made for you─only blessed siblings could hope to defeat Gulool Ja Ja.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002420_ZEREELJA
261.description: But ere we begin, I would see the fruits of your triumphs. Come, show me your tablets.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002430_ZEREELJA
262.description: What is this? Where are your keystones?

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002450_ZEREELJA
264.description: No matter. Not all can be expected to go to plan. What keystones you lack...

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002470_BAKOOLJAJA
266.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I...I tried. B-But I couldn't─I cannot beat her.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002480_ZEREELJA
267.description: You mean to tell me that you, glory of Mamook─for whom all here have sacrificed─were defeated by your inferiors?

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002490_ZEREELJA
269.description: You are as useless as your siblings. A failure.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002500_ZEREELJA
270.description: Leave and never return! You have no place here!

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002520_BAKOOLJAJA
272.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)...Let's go, Brother.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002530_ZEREELJA
273.description: Worthless! Pathetic! This was our chance to claim sovereignty, and he ruins it!

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002540_ZEREELJA
274.description: But...when these stragglers fail, Gulool Ja Ja will be forced to extend his rule. And in the next rite of succession, we will present a better claimant.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002550_ZEREELJA
275.description: So come. Stand before me...and fall.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002570_ZEREELJA
277.description: Oh? You intend to forfeit the rite?

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002580_WUKLAMAT
278.description: Papa wants his successor to intimately understand the country he loves.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002590_WUKLAMAT
279.description: Every step of my journey, I've learned something about our peoples and their cultures. I would do the same here in Mamook.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002600_WUKLAMAT
280.description: The Mamool Ja deserve nothing less. So your battle can wait.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002610_KOANA
281.description: I'm of the same mind. Father named you an elector for a reason. There must be something that he would have us learn.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002620_ZEREELJA
283.description: Do as you will. But until you triumph over the shade, you shall proceed no further.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002625_MIILALJA
284.description: (-Dignified Lady-)Promise. I would speak with you. Meet me on the western outskirts.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002640_MIILALJA
286.description: The stone pier yonder... That is our destination.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002650_ALPHINAUD
287.description: To erect it there would have been no small feat.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002660_MIILALJA
288.description: The work of Yok Huy hands, built long, long ago. Our forebears merely altered the entrance.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002680_MIILALJA
290.description: It will be quicker to show you. We have beasts that can carry us below.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002700_BAKOOLJAJA
292.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)...What, couldn't wait to laugh at the failure?

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002710_MIILALJA
293.description: You've always come here to cry. Ever since you were little.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002740_MIILALJA
296.description: The Third Promise seeks to learn about Mamook. She may be our chance to finally end what we have been powerless to stop.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002750_MIILALJA
297.description: Talk with her. Tell her...what we have done.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002760_BAKOOLJAJA
298.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Fine. Perhaps it's only right that we be the ones to speak of it. “Blessed” as we are...

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002780_BAKOOLJAJA
300.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)This vessel holds the remains of a two-headed Mamool Ja. An infant.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002790_BAKOOLJAJA
301.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We converted the ruins into a cenotaph so the souls of these children wouldn't return as vengeful spirits.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002800_BAKOOLJAJA
302.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Do you know how blessed siblings are made?

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002810_KRILE
303.description: I've heard that they are born to Hoobigo and Boonewa parents.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002820_BAKOOLJAJA
304.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Such unions between clans were originally arranged to stop infighting. The war against the Xbr'aal was going poorly, and we needed to be united.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002830_BAKOOLJAJA
305.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Then one day, a child was born. One blessed with two heads...and tremendous power.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002840_BAKOOLJAJA
306.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)When this child grew old enough to lead our army, we became unstoppable. The Xbr'aal had no answer, and we drove them all the way back to the trees above.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002850_BAKOOLJAJA
307.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That taste of victory awakened our greed. We became obsessed with conceiving more and more of these superior children. No matter the cost...

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002860_BAKOOLJAJA
308.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Of the countless born, most die...trapped in their shells.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002870_BAKOOLJAJA
309.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Only one in a hundred survive.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002880_BAKOOLJAJA
310.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)If we are “blessed,” it is only because we yet live. Unlike our brothers and sisters who were sacrificed for the glory of Mamook.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002900_BAKOOLJAJA
312.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Of course it's horrible! It's an atrocity we can never take back!

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002910_BAKOOLJAJA
313.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Those children died so that we could live! So we <hex:021A020203>had<hex:021A020103> to succeed, no matter what! To fail would mean it was all for nothing! ...<hex:021A020203>Nothing<hex:021A020103>!

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002920_BAKOOLJAJA
314.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)...But I did fail. I squandered their sacrifice.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A1_100_001_NONE_VOICE
316.description: I sympathize with your pain, but...

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A1_100_002_NONE_VOICE
317.description: Don't use them as an excuse.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002925_BAKOOLJAJA
319.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I...I should never have been born.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002940_WUKLAMAT
322.description: You didn't ask to be born as you are, and─you aren't responsible for your siblings' deaths.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002950_WUKLAMAT
323.description: The people obsessed with blessed siblings are. They made their choices...but they don't make yours!

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002960_WUKLAMAT
324.description: Since when do you let others push you around, Bakool Ja Ja? What do <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> want? Say it!

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002970_BAKOOLJAJA
325.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I...want it to end.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002980_BAKOOLJAJA
326.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I don't want any more to die.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_002990_WUKLAMAT
327.description: Then you have my word. We'll put a stop to this madness.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003000_ALPHINAUD
328.description: Blessed siblings are revered by their supporters as a means to achieve dominance in Tural.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003010_ALPHINAUD
329.description: If we understand why they harbor such aspirations in the first place, we would be better equipped to treat with them.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003020_KRILE
330.description: Indeed. I just hope they will be open to discourse...

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003030_BAKOOLJAJA
331.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Take me with you. Those fanatics treat my words as gospel.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003040_MIILALJA
332.description: No. There will be trouble if your father finds out you're still here.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003050_MIILALJA
333.description: Moxutural Zooj─there we will gather the people, and ask anything the Third Promise wishes to know.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003060_BAKOOLJAJA
334.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Then take one of my scales, one that blends the Hoobigo and Boonewa coloring. It'll serve as proof that you have our trust.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003070_BAKOOLJAJA
335.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)People will do as you say if you show it to them.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003080_BAKOOLJAJA
336.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'm sorry. For what I've said...and done. I don't expect your forgiveness.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003090_WUKLAMAT
337.description: You had your reasons. I'm glad I could know them.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003100_WUKLAMAT
338.description: Which is to say...you're not a complete alpaca's ass.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003130_ALISAIE
347.description: Well, maybe it's for the best. Hatred is exhausting, after all.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003140_ALPHINAUD
348.description: Indeed. So let us make the most of our newfound friendship and bring together the people of Mamook. We have much to discover.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003150_WUKLAMAT
349.description: Zereel Ja! I'm ready for the final feat!

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003160_ZEREELJA
350.description: Hmph. Grown weary of postponing the inevitable, have you?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003170_WUKLAMAT
351.description: Something like that. You see, I've learned all sorts of things about Mamook and your people.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003180_ZEREELJA
352.description: Is that supposed to impress me?

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003190_WUKLAMAT
353.description: I now understand why I need to surpass blessed siblings.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003200_WUKLAMAT
354.description: The cost of producing “superior” offspring is destroying your people's souls. Look at them and you'll see this.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003210_WUKLAMAT
355.description: So I'll defeat my father's shade and prove to you that there's a better path for Mamook!

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003220_ZEREELJA
356.description: What drivel. Without the blessed, we are nothing but weaklings─doomed to fade into obscurity!

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003230_WUKLAMAT
357.description: Of course you're weak. We all are, each and every one of us.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003235_WUKLAMAT
358.description: But when we join hands, we gain the strength to overcome any foe─even Valigarmanda!

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003240_ZEREELJA
359.description: Enough talk. Prove your mettle against Gulool Ja Ja, the finest warrior ever to have graced Tural!

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003250_WUKLAMAT
360.description: Fine by me. Not even Papa's shade will stop me from upholding his legacy!

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003270_ZEREELJA
362.description: Claimants are not permitted to assist one another, Second Promise. But you may observe your sister's pitiable attempt.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003290_KOANA
364.description: It seems I'm no longer a claimant. I am now free to participate, I trust?

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003310_KOANA
366.description: Nothing. I've simply come to realize who is worthy of following in Father's footsteps.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003320_KOANA
367.description: Not our brother. Not Bakool Ja Ja. And not me.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003330_KOANA
368.description: You have always held the happiness of our people closest to your heart, Lamaty'i. So I will do everything in my power to ensure you ascend to the throne.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003340_KOANA
369.description: This is how I shall repay Father for his kindness. This is how I shall serve Tuliyollal!

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003350_WUKLAMAT
370.description: I could always count on you, Koana. Thank you.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003360_ZEREELJA
371.description: Hmph. It will make no difference. Numbers matter not in the face of true might.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003370_ZEREELJA
372.description: Gulool Ja Ja, mightiest of the blessed...arise!

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003390_WUKLAMAT
374.description: No hard feelings, Papa! I've got a lot of hopes riding on my shoulders─and the only way forward is through you!

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003400_WUKLAMAT
375.description: That's my old man for you...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003420_KETENRAMM
377.description: (-???-)Ain't that a bit stubborn? Even for you.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003450_KETENRAMM
380.description: (-Tankwa-)It has indeed. You're lookin' more imposin' since last I saw you, Wuk Lamat.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003470_KETENRAMM
382.description: (-Tankwa-)My Turali moniker. Gulool Ja Ja insisted I take one, sayin' my birth name was too cumbersome for the local tongues.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003480_ALPHINAUD
383.description: That birth name being “Ketenramm,” I presume.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003500_WUKLAMAT
385.description: Ketenramm's that legendary Eorzean sailor! The one with the pickled cabbage!

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003510_KETENRAMM
386.description: ...We can talk about me cabbage later.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003520_KETENRAMM
387.description: Zereel Ja. Whether you like it or no, these young'uns accomplished the feat.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003530_KETENRAMM
388.description: To deny Wuk Lamat her reward would be to betray the Dawnservant's trust.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003540_ZEREELJA
389.description: And what should she be rewarded for!? Calling upon her minions to carry her to victory!?

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
391.description: We're not minions. We're Wuk Lamat's friends and comrades.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
392.description: You're the Autarch of Mamook. Show some dignity.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003550_ZEREELJA
393.description: Comrades... You believe a ruler should be reliant upon such?

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003560_ZEREELJA
394.description: I don't have dignity. Not anymore. I wagered everything on this feat.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003570_ZEREELJA
395.description: And by the same token, I understand the enormity of your accomplishment.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003580_WUKLAMAT
396.description: Together, we can achieve anything. You needn't place your faith in the promise of blessed siblings.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003590_ZEREELJA
397.description: How would you have us reclaim our glory?

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003600_WUKLAMAT
399.description: With friendship and community. With us.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003610_ZEREELJA
400.description: If you mean to rule, you should be more sparing with your offers of clemency. Especially to a man who has sacrificed countless young lives.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003620_ZEREELJA
401.description: Nevertheless...I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> fulfill my charge as elector. In recognition of your feat...I bestow upon you a keystone.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003630_KOANA
402.description: Congratulations...are nearly in order, I suppose. I'm confident that you will find the golden city in no time.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003640_KOANA
403.description: You've grown much and more during this journey. Become someone ready to lead our nation.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003650_KOANA
404.description: Little Lamaty'i no longer. As your brother, I couldn't be more proud.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003670_KOANA
406.description: I must express my gratitude for your cooperation...and my regret for failing to live up to expectations.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003680_THANCRED
407.description: Nonsense. If you believe Wuk Lamat is the woman for the job, then you have our wholehearted support.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003690_KOANA
408.description: One last thing. I wish to speak to you both from the heart. Unpracticed as I am, this may sound hackneyed, but...

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003700_KOANA
409.description: I am truly grateful to have met you.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003710_URIANGER
412.description: Words spoken with such feeling would resonate with any fortunate enough to hear them.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003720_URIANGER
413.description: Though our journey together hath ended, ever shall we cherish the memories.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003730_THANCRED
414.description: Aye. And should you require further esoteric musings or biting witticisms, don't hesitate to call. I daresay we'll come flocking.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003740_THANCRED
415.description: But I get ahead of myself. As I recall, our contract remains in effect until we've escorted the Second Promise back to the capital.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003750_KOANA
416.description: I leave my sister in your capable hands. See that she returns home safely!

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003760_KETENRAMM
417.description: You've still malms to go yet, Wuk Lamat. The rite ain't over till ye find the city of gold.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003770_WUKLAMAT
418.description: I know. But if I can come this far, I can go all the way.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003780_KRILE
419.description: I thought this place was of Yok Huy origin...but is this glowing stone their creation as well?

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003790_ERENVILLE
420.description: I don't believe so. I've never seen anything like it.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003800_KRILE
421.description: Then it's from an even older time?

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003810_ALISAIE
422.description: Don't tell me it's the Allagans again...

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003820_ALPHINAUD
423.description: While careful study would be required to confirm, it does not appear to be reminiscent of their designs.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003830_KRILE
424.description: A golden light... Could it be...?

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003840_WUKLAMAT
425.description: There's a platform on the other side. But how do we get over there...?

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003860_WUKLAMAT
427.description: Right then. Let's go and take a look.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003870_KRILE
428.description: That seal... That's Sharlayan and no mistake!

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003900_ALPHINAUD
431.description: Your tablets might be a good fit, wouldn't you say?

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003920_WUKLAMAT
433.description: Is this it? The golden city?

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003930_KRILE
434.description: Though there is some resemblance, it doesn't quite live up to what the Yok Huy described from their dreams...

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003940_GULOOLJAJA
435.description: Aaahahaha! Well done. Well done, indeed!

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003950_GULOOLJAJA
436.description: You, my dear daughter, have found the entrance to the city of gold and triumphed in the rite of succession.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003970_WUKLAMAT
438.description: We made it to the end!

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003980_GULOOLJAJA
439.description: You seem more perplexed than joyous.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_003990_KRILE
440.description: It's just...this place is unlike anything we've seen in Tural, never mind the peculiar stone.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004000_KRILE
441.description: So I am given to wonder...what exactly lies beyond that gate?

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004020_GULOOLJAJA
443.description: Nothing less than the golden city of legend, I assure you─though circumstance prevents us from opening the gate.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004030_GULOOLJAJA
444.description: As to what the city is and what Galuf Baldesion discovered all those years ago...

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004040_GULOOLJAJA
445.description: This knowledge and more I will share with you after your ascension. What you choose to do with it will be up to you.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004060_ERENVILLE
447.description: It took a while, but I finally found it...

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004080_GULOOLJAJA
449.description: Come, let us return to Tuliyollal!

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004096_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
452.description: The day of the Dawnservant ascension ceremony...

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004100_ALISAIE
453.description: What a crowd! As befits the changing of Dawnservants.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004140_XBALAALMALEAUDA
457.description: The Head of Reason is resting again... Thought he'd grace us for this occasion at least.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004150_GULOOLJAJA
458.description: People of Tuliyollal! You honor us with your presence.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004160_GULOOLJAJA
459.description: For on this auspicious day, we witness the dusking of one era and the dawning of the next. The succession of Dawnservants!

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004170_GULOOLJAJA
460.description: Heh! But I've talked for long enough. Allow me to present the claimant whose determination, wisdom, and compassion guided them to triumph and the city of gold!

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004200_PELUPELUMALEAUDA
463.description: Long live the Dawnservant! Long live Tuliyollal!

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004210_WUKLAMAT
464.description: Growing up in this city, I used to think I knew all there was to know about Tuliyollal.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004220_WUKLAMAT
465.description: But my journey showed me how much I had yet to learn about the cultures, histories, and aspirations of this nation.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004230_WUKLAMAT
466.description: Through the time-honored Ihih'hana, the Hanuhanu taught me how they nourish and cultivate both the land and their bonds with visitors.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004240_WUKLAMAT
467.description: And with their alpacas and tradecraft, the Pelupelu showed me the depths of their patience and fortitude. To know when to push through...and when not to push your luck.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004250_WUKLAMAT
468.description: From the Moblins and their artisans, I gained insight into the power of creativity. That it is when we are filled with passion and bolstered by the support of others that we produce our best works.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004260_WUKLAMAT
469.description: I was moved by the history and hopes of the Yok Huy, who believe that death isn't the end. That we live on so long as we're remembered.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004270_WUKLAMAT
470.description: I felt joy and harmony in Yak T'el when I tasted xibruq pibil. The dish that marked the beginning of peace between the Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja after centuries of warfare.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004280_WUKLAMAT
471.description: And...I felt sorrow in Mamook when I met with those who placed their faith in the promise of blessed siblings, and for this were burdened with great suffering.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004290_WUKLAMAT
472.description: Through the understanding we forged, I'm hopeful that they will find what they seek through friendship and community. For we are all Turali.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004300_BOONEWAFEMALEAUD
473.description: Understanding with Mamook? What sorcery did she use on them...?

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004310_WUKLAMAT
474.description: All of which is to say that, as I've come to know our nation, I've seen the ways in which we thrive, and the ways in which we still struggle.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004320_WUKLAMAT
475.description: Some in Kozama'uka must resort to banditry to survive. A faction of Yok Huy still cling to dreams of conquest. Not everyone lives in peace and plenty.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004330_WUKLAMAT
476.description: And there's still so much of Tuliyollal I don't know. Places I haven't seen and people I haven't met.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004340_WUKLAMAT
477.description: That's why I hope to keep learning about and from you, that we might build a nation where everyone knows happiness.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004350_WUKLAMAT
478.description: Because my journey has taught me one thing above all else: your happiness is my happiness!

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004360_WUKLAMAT
479.description: I say mine, but the Dawnservant doesn't need to be a single person, does it?

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004370_ERENVILLE
480.description: Oh dear... What is she doing?

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004380_WUKLAMAT
483.description: My father led Tuliyollal to prosperity by the resolve and reason of his two heads.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004390_WUKLAMAT
484.description: But my one head can only get us so far. To further change our nation for the better, I'll need someone else.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004400_WUKLAMAT
485.description: Someone with the knowledge and insight that I lack.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004405_WUKLAMAT
486.description: So what do you say? Be Dawnservant with me, Koana!

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004420_WUKLAMAT
488.description: Absolutely. You take Reason and I take Resolve. Together, we make a full Dawnservant.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004440_GULOOLJAJA
490.description: You'll have no objections from me, of course!

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004450_GULOOLJAJA
491.description: But mine is not the approval you need.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004460_KOANA
492.description: During my time abroad, I experienced the benefits of foreign technologies, some of which I introduced to our nation.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004470_KOANA
493.description: Dirigibles now soar the sky in the south, while locomotives traverse the land in the north.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004480_KOANA
494.description: I was convinced that by imitating foreign powers, we could assert our strength and thereby deter invasion.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004490_KOANA
495.description: Yet despite my intentions, I failed to understand what I was too eager to cast aside, and the very people I wished to protect.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004500_KOANA
496.description: My own journey has taught me that culture isn't a hindrance to progress, but a shared value that binds us, connecting lives and generations.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004510_KOANA
497.description: With your blessing, I vow to help Tuliyollal prosper in a way that honors the hopes and heritage of all her peoples. My esteemed predecessor would accept nothing less.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004520_KOANA
498.description: For ultimately, I harbor the same wish as my sister: to give you cause to smile. That is my heartfelt desire.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004530_WUKLAMAT
499.description: Hehe! Glad this didn't go to waste.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004540_WUKLAMAT
500.description: This is the Lay of Legacy! The part of the Tuliyollal Saga where you and I become the next Dawnservant.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004550_KOANA
501.description: Good heavens... Don't tell me this is what kept you so busy ahead of the ceremony.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004560_WUKLAMAT
502.description: Just so you know, I didn't decide this on a whim. After reflecting on all we've been through, I realized it was the only answer.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004570_GULOOLJAJA
503.description: With this, both my brother and I have worthy successors. ...He would have been proud.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004590_GULOOLJAJA
505.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)It's been three years since my brother left us...

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004600_TONAWAATAUQMALEAUDA
506.description: It cannot be... The Head of Reason is no longer with us?

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004620_WUKLAMAT
508.description: I didn't want to believe it...

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004630_GULOOLJAJA
509.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)I'm sorry I never told you. We wanted the people to rest easy until our successor could be chosen.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004640_GULOOLJAJA
510.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)Planning the rite was my brother's final duty. He was determined for it to serve the nation's best interests, and labored nigh without cease.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004650_GULOOLJAJA
511.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)And then he died, forcing me to do the actual work. Sneaky bastard.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004660_GULOOLJAJA
512.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)But he did well, I have to give him that. The outcome speaks for itself.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004670_GULOOLJAJA
513.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)Though not quite to the original script, your new Dawnservant rises!

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004675_GULOOLJAJA
514.description: (-Vow of Resolve Gulool Ja Ja-)May they shine resplendent, and their rule bring light ever greater to Tuliyollal!

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004690_KETENRAMM
516.description: Change is in the air, and it's all because of our little firebrand.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004700_KETENRAMM
517.description: Every ilm her father's daughter, that one.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004710_KETENRAMM
518.description: I'll be watchin' where you steer this nation, lass. With what time I've got left.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004730_ALISAIE
520.description: Seen everyone you wanted to see?

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004740_WUKLAMAT
521.description: I have. Sorry for keeping you all.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004750_WUKLAMAT
522.description: Now, there's just one last matter. What Koana spoke to you about.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004760_WUKLAMAT
523.description: I'm sure he made it abundantly clear, but I'm completely serious.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004770_WUKLAMAT
524.description: I want you to stay in Tuliyollal with me.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004780_WUKLAMAT
525.description: ...I'm not forcing you, of course. But should you wish it, you'll always have a place here.

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004790_WUKLAMAT
526.description: Ah, that's right. This is for you.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004800_WUKLAMAT
527.description: A permit granting passage to Xak Tural, which as I recall, you've yet to see.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004805_WUKLAMAT
528.description: An adventurer like you could hardly resist, no?

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004810_WUKLAMAT
529.description: I can't believe our journey is over already!

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004820_WUKLAMAT
530.description: You accepted me as a comrade and stood with me to the end.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004830_WUKLAMAT
531.description: You have my eternal gratitude. Thank you.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004840_WUKLAMAT
532.description: Well, I had better get going. I need to start learning all my official Dawnservant duties.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004845_WUKLAMAT
533.description: I'll be sure to share what my old man says about the golden city too, once he tells me.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004850_WUKLAMAT
534.description: Till then, feel free to pass the time as you like.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004860_ERENVILLE
535.description: For now, I will remain in Tural. There's someone I'd like to see before returning to Sharlayan.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004870_WUKLAMAT
536.description: What about the rest of you?

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004880_ALPHINAUD
537.description: Alisaie and I also intend to remain a while longer. As educational as this experience has been thus far, we feel there are even more lessons to be had for Garlemald.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004890_ALPHINAUD
538.description: By hearing about the peace your father facilitated, and then seeing you reforge relations with Mamook, we were reminded of a profound truth.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004900_ALPHINAUD
539.description: That is, acceptance begins with understanding.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004910_ALISAIE
540.description: And like you demonstrated throughout the rite, there are unexpected-yet-effective ways for two sides to understand each other.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004920_ALISAIE
541.description: The question is how to encourage it, and by seeing more of this nation born of unity, we hope to find some hints.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004930_KRILE
542.description: Personally, I can hardly wait to learn more about the city of gold. So if I may, I'd like to stay in Tuliyollal as well.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004935_WUKLAMAT
543.description: By all means! Your rooms are at your disposal for as long as you need them.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004940_ALISAIE
544.description: And what of you? Thinking of touring Xak Tural, perhaps?

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
547.description: I'm still undecided, to be honest.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004950_ALISAIE
548.description: Of course. You're hardly the type to leave half a continent unexplored.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004960_ERENVILLE
549.description: Then perhaps we could travel together?

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004970_ERENVILLE
550.description: The person I intend to meet is my mentor, so I'll be visiting my hometown in Xak Tural.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_004980_ERENVILLE
551.description: If you have no particular destination in mind, I'd be happy to guide you en route.

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_005020_ERENVILLE
555.description: When you're ready, come and meet me at the Xak Tural skygate.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07002_005030_WUKLAMAT
556.description: We're friends to the end, you hear me! Friends to the end!
